headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty end lower, snapping a four-week winning streak amid profit booking

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Profit booking weighed on benchmark indices following mid-week recovery
Brent crude oil prices topped $97, dampening investor sentiment
IT stocks faced drag pressure during the recent trading sessions
Upside risks to inflation persist despite resilient Q3 growth expectations
whatHappening: Nifty 50 and Sensex snapped their four-week winning streak to end in the red on the last trading session
TCS led weekly gains among major stocks while Tata Steel lagged performance
India's exports surged 45% to an all-time high, influenced partly by high crude costs
Cable and wire manufacturers announced fresh price reductions
summary: On the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty ended lower, snapping a four-week rally as profit booking and Brent crude topping $97 impacted sentiment. TCS led weekly gains while Tata Steel lagged the overall market performance. Indian stock markets remain closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 30 November.
